sparse_bin_rule: Flag insufficient_support if correct<10 or wrong<10 or dialogues<3. Retain all rows, no selecting winners.

matching.algorithm: Sort each class by utterance_index. Hungarian linear_sum_assignment: real edge cost=abs(C_correct-C_wrong) if <=.02 else1e6; n_correct dummy columns each cost 1+(min(n_correct,n_wrong)+1)*.02. Maximizes valid pair count before minimizing total confidence distance. No behavior values used to match.
matching.direction: wrong behavior minus correct behavior; no assumed error sensitivity
matching.support_flag: Flag low support if pairs<10 or matched Dialogues<3; report all results.

bootstrap.unit: same frozen Dialogue draws across five seeds, metric computed separately per seed then averaged
bootstrap.paired_statistic: mean(wrong_behavior-correct_behavior) over matched pairs per seed; Dialogue resampling weights all its pairs
bootstrap.invalid_draws: If any seed has zero matched pairs in a resample, that resample is invalid; never silently drop missing seeds. Report valid draw count.
bootstrap.confidence: percentile95%, exploratory, no refit or multiple-comparison adjustment

stability: Recompute Spearman and Pearson from three existing 5/5 splits for mu/delta. First average available split correlations per model seed, then mean and sampleSD across five seeds. Fifteen splits are not independent datasets. Constant vectors unestimable, CSV NA.
noise_diagnostic: Existing confidence_change_std is ddof=0 over10 repeats: sample_sd=pop_sd*sqrt(10/9), SE(mean signed confidence change)=pop_sd/sqrt(9). delta=abs(mean signed change), so ratio delta/SE describes signal/noise only; it is not a confidence interval or a test for absolute delta. Zero SE flagged and ratio NA.
unconditional_risk_auc: ROC AUC using mu/delta as larger-is-error scores. Chance .5, reverse directions reported without data-driven flipping. Descriptive association, not calibration gain.
prioritization: Root ranks measurement-repeats validation vs modality confirmation vs more scoring complexity vs raw-data experiments, using documented stability/sparsity/conditional support; no automatic GPU tasks or new calibrator.
constraints: No new perturbations or repeat-count changes
No reliability mapping fitting or model selection
Conditional bins/matching are approximate descriptions, not proof of conditional independence or unseen calibration benefit
